title: CustomEntityTags
description: Tag to categorize mobs from different mods and vanilla
body:
Add Custom Tags to entities of different mods, including:
- Ars Nouveau & Ars Elemental
- Goety
- Modular Golems
- Botania & Botanic Pledge & MythicBotany
- Mowzie's Mobs
- Alex's Mobs
- Alex's Caves
- Friends and Foes
- Cataclysm
- Illage and Spillage

Currently having:
- Skeletal
- Automaton (Golems and such, would not be organic)
- Ethereal (Ghosts and Elemental)
- Other (Irregular such as creepers)
- Possessed (Animated objects such as flying tomes and knight phantom)
- Slime
- Summon (Conjured non permanent entities such as familiars)
- Burning (Innate fire characteristics)
- Freezing (Innate icy characteristics)
- Shocking (Innately charged and discharging)
